title: The Sanatorium Retainer
logline: A patient at an elite recovery habitat hires a pilot to smuggle out unmedicated blood samples proving the clinic's celebrated treatment is a mild sedative designed to keep wealthy families paying lifelong board.

roles.description: An estranged freight scion attempting to finish a mandatory sobriety cure; lucid, cynical, desperate to leave.
Oversees the orbital convalescent suites; polite, calculating, terrified of losing paying long-term residents.
Controls the heir's trust fund; efficient, unsentimental, prefers paying quiet institutional board over public scandals.
A tranquil sunlit orbital habitat advertising peaceful recovery retreats to wealthy families.
A chilled medical container holding three unadulterated patient blood samples drawn before the evening dose.

public_situation: The convalescent habitat in {system} reports flawless patient contentment, though no resident has taken discharge in eighteen months.
private_truth: The director blends low-dose neural dampeners into the habitat's mineral tea, keeping residents too placid to request release while their estates pay lifelong fees.

beats.public_change: A private courier listing appears on the station board requesting discreet transport of clinical research samples.

missions.reason: He managed to siphon his own unmedicated morning blood samples into a cooler and needs an outsider to take custody before the ward doctor inspects his locker.
missions.private_fact: He knows his family prefers paying the clinic's monthly fee over having him return home to claim his inheritance.

beats.public_change: The sanatorium director issues an urgent station-wide bulletin claiming a patient stole experimental sedatives.

missions.reason: She needs the heir's quarterly estate remittance voucher delivered directly to the clinic director, but wants the delivery verified by someone outside the family firm.
missions.private_fact: She suspects the heir is actually lucid, but her contract bonuses depend on keeping the estate's capital undivided.

beats.public_change: An independent assay buoy at the station dock finishes comparing the blood samples against standard convalescent tea.

missions.reason: He needs a pilot to scan the habitat's central dispensing manifold and certify whether the sedative additive matches his blood assay.
missions.private_fact: The director already offered the trustee a forty percent discount if the heir remains committed for life.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds clear proof that the sanatorium is drugging its residents. The heir wants freedom, the trustee wants quiet, and the director offers silence.

options.label: Deliver the chemical proof to the estate trustee
Sell the test records back to the sanatorium director

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies the sedative and delivers the assay proof to the estate trustee.
resolutions.summary: {role:recovering_heir} secures an immediate discharge, while {role:estate_trustee} uses the fraud to seize the sanatorium's operational leases.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the fancy orbital clinic was doping heirs to milk their trust funds.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies the sedative but sells the proof back to the sanatorium director.
resolutions.summary: {role:sanatorium_director} buries the analysis, while {role:recovering_heir} remains sedated in luxury under a doubled estate retainer.

consequences.public_summary: Whispers circulate that a courier took clinic credits to bury a patient's lab results.

resolutions.reached_by: The assay records are sealed or the pilot never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: {role:sanatorium_director} continues administering the placid regimen, keeping {role:recovering_heir} boarded and the estate accounts flowing.

loose_threads.detail: The habitat's patient roster lists thirty names whose boarding fees are all paid from the same anonymous offshore holding company.
Every medical sedative canister carries a recycled factory cap bearing the inventory seal of a commercial freight line.

radio_hooks: {role:convalescent_station} boasts highest patient retention rate in {system}.
Family offices report steady returns as trust funds remain consolidated.
Dockworkers report strange herbal deliveries to orbital wellness suites.

voice_direction.recovering_heir: Speaks with trembling intensity, choosing words with defensive precision. Never raises his voice above a harsh murmur.
voice_direction.sanatorium_director: Soothing clinical cadence with calculated pauses. Avoids clinical drug names in favor of wellness buzzwords.
voice_direction.estate_trustee: Dry, brisk accounting rhythm. Treats human custody as a column of administrative debits and credits.
